text:
Residents:
Yuki (50s) works from home. Weekdays: at desk (bedroom_1) 9:00-17:30. Often out for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s) works in town. Weekdays: out 8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.
Weekends: Both sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day.
Note: Nora was home sick on Thursday.

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items (Walkthrough Tue 18:00):
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet. Wardrobe had gym bag.
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Hat, jacket, scarf, shoes on hook. Keys, wallet on table. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dishes in cupboard/sink. Dog bowl on floor. Dog food in pantry.
- Living: Standard furniture items.

Dynamic Items (Current Status Fri 23:59):
- Bedroom 1: Yuki’s laptop, pen, charger, mug, water bottle on desk_b1. Yuki’s phone, tablet on nightstand_b1. Blanket, towel on bed_b1. Laundry basket in wardrobe_b1.
- Bedroom 2: Nora’s book on armchair_l1 (moved from couch). Glass on nightstand_b2.
- Living: Board game, book_nora on armchair_l1. Laptop_nora, notebook, pen, scarf, backpack, lunchbox on entry_hook_e1.
- Kitchen: Mugs, glasses, plates, water bottles on kitchen_table_k1. Knife, spatula, cutting board, pan, pot, shopping bag on counter_k1. Dishes in sink/dish_rack.
- Entry: Keys_nora, sunglasses, wallet on entry_table_e1. Keys_yuki on entry_table_e1. Shoes_nora on shoe_rack_e1. Shoes_yuki on shoe_rack_e1. Hat_yuki on entry_hook_e1.
- Bathroom: Skincare_nora, toiletry_bag_nora on sink_ba_ba1. Towel_nora on towel_rack_ba1.

Inference:
Nora left for work at 12:00 (items removed) and returned at 20:00 (items returned). Yuki was home all day.
Items taken out of the house on Friday:
- 08:00: Yuki’s phone removed (likely for lunch/errand).
- 12:00: Nora’s work/commute items (backpack, jacket, keys, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, water bottle) removed.
- 20:00: All of Nora’s items returned. Yuki’s phone returned.

Routine Adjustments:
- Dog leash: Usually on entry_hook_e1. Taken out for walks.
- Nora’s work items: Usually in bedroom_2 or entry. Taken out for work on weekdays.
- Yuki’s work items: Usually on desk_b1. Stays home.
- Keys: Usually on entry_table_e1 or hook. Taken out when leaving.
- Yuki’s phone: Often moves between desk, nightstand, and out of house during lunch breaks.
